items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer and John Best thanking him. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: John was interviewed in San Diego, California on February 15, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe, and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in San Diego, California, and I am very, very pleased to have Johnny Best, big band trumpeter and notable musician throughout many, many years of American music. Thank you so much for joining me today.
Well thank you for having me.
